desc: Pixel art, side view: the huge pink paint goo Doberman lies horizontally on its back along the bottom of the picture, head on the left turned up with a lewd smirk, its broad chest facing up; both thick goo arms curl up and over in a tight sticky bear hug around an empty space just above its chest, where someone lies on top of it; thick stretchy goo strands hang from the arms and glue everything together, dripping.
